title: 阅读笔记填空
goal: 按笔记层级和并列关系提取信息。

points.label: 识别笔记中的上下位层级
依据并列关系提取对应信息

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 阅读笔记填空的教学内容

body.p: 笔记用标题和缩进组织信息。标题表示概念或主题，缩进项目列出下位内容。
笔记项目常省略主语或谓语。省略的关系可以从原文和同级项目中补出。

steps.d: 确定笔记的主题和下位类别。Causes of delay 下的项目应表示延误原因。
观察缩进和并列项目。Tools 下的 brushes 和 rollers 均指工具。
寻找与标题及项目关系相符的句子。核对原因、例子和定义的归属。
按题面要求提取原词，或从词库中选词。填好后核对词数，并检查所填内容与同级项目是否属于同一类。

body.box:
The exhibition was postponed because a window leaked and the floor needed repair. The paintings remained in storage.

Reasons for postponement:
  • a leaking window
  • repairs to the _____
Complete with ONE WORD from the passage.

body.p: 依据是 the floor needed repair。两个缩进项目是延期的原因，填 floor；paintings 是存放的对象。

groups.text:
A seed library lends packets of seed to gardeners who agree to return seed from suitable plants after harvest. Unlike a conventional library, it does not expect the same physical objects to come back. Its collection consists of named varieties that can be grown and recorded locally. The library keeps a catalogue so that each packet can be traced to the information supplied by its donor.

Before accepting a packet, volunteers check that it has a label identifying the plant and the year of collection. They then inspect the contents for obvious damage. Packets without a collection year are held separately until the donor provides it. The volunteers store accepted packets in a dry cupboard and record their location in the catalogue. The catalogue also notes any growing information supplied with the seed, but the volunteers do not treat that information as a guarantee of the next harvest.

Gardeners borrowing seed receive a short sheet explaining how to return material. The sheet asks them to collect from healthy plants and to keep different varieties apart. It also asks them to dry the seed before packing it. The library does not require every borrower to return a packet, since some crops may fail. At the end of the season, volunteers count the packets received and compare the total with their catalogue. The count helps them plan storage for the following year; it does not measure the number of plants grown in the community. The system depends on accurate labels as well as careful handling.

Seed library
  Definition: a collection lending packets of (1)
  Required label details:
    • plant name
    • collection (2)
  Before return: dry the (3)

items.stem: Complete (1) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: A seed library lends packets of seed 给出定义。

items.stem: Complete (2) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 a label identifying the plant and the year of collection。plant name 已列出，并列的另一项是 year。

items.stem: Complete (3) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: dry the seed before packing it 说明归还前的处理。

groups.text:
A local theatre decided to document how it prepared costumes for reuse. At the end of each production, staff separated garments that could be stored from those needing attention. They made a list of each item's condition before deciding whether cleaning or repair was needed. The list also included the name of the production, but this was recorded as background information rather than as a measure of condition.

Several problems could delay the return of a garment to storage. A missing button had to be replaced, and a torn seam needed stitching. Staff also checked whether a garment had a readable label. When a label was missing, they identified the item from the production records and attached a new one. These tasks had different purposes: repair made the garment usable, while labelling made it easier to find. The theatre kept spare buttons and labels in separate drawers so that each could be located without searching through costume boxes.

Once a garment was ready, staff placed it on a suitable hanger or folded it in a box. They entered the storage location in a register. The register was updated whenever an item moved to another room. Staff reviewed the list before a later production borrowed any garment, because a record of its previous use did not by itself establish its current condition. This system gave the theatre a way to maintain its collection across productions. It also provided a record that could be checked when a garment could not immediately be found.

Costume records
  Reasons for repair:
    • a missing (1)
    • a torn (2)
  Finding garments:
    • attach a readable (3)

items.stem: Choose ONE WORD from the word bank for (1).
items.why: 依据是 A missing button had to be replaced。这是第一条修理原因，填 button。

items.stem: Choose ONE WORD from the word bank for (2).
items.why: 依据是 a torn seam needed stitching。它与缺纽扣并列，填 seam。

items.stem: Choose ONE WORD from the word bank for (3).
items.why: 依据是 attached a new one 和 labelling made it easier to find。查找靠的是 label。
